stages.label: Learn the jumps
stages.tip: Start with the marked stunt jumps near the city: same approach, same landing, build the habit before the count matters.

stages.label: City circuits
stages.tip: Sweep district by district and mark each jump as you land it; the tracker above keeps your running count.

stages.label: Outskirts and islands
stages.tip: Finish the far jumps in one dedicated pass with a fast bike; re-check the tracker so none is logged twice.

stages.label: Ranges 1–4
stages.tip: Gold every challenge at the first four ranges before moving on; the early ones teach the timing.

stages.label: Ranges 5–8
stages.tip: Same drill, harder targets: slow down for the long shots and re-run any silver immediately.

stages.label: Ranges 9–12
stages.tip: Last four ranges. Gold medals only count, so do not bank a silver and move on.

stages.label: Chapter 1 balcony (missable window)
stages.tip: Do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house in Chapter 1, then make a manual save. It disappears after the chapter and no source confirms the trophy works without it.

stages.label: Coast and Keys spots
stages.tip: Work the coastal spots in one pass; each spot can host more than one meditation.

stages.label: Inland and city spots
stages.tip: Finish the inland and city spots last; the tracker shows your running count.

stages.label: City traffic
stages.tip: Scan everything you pass in the city first; common models fill the first half fast.

stages.label: Highways and rural
stages.tip: Trucks, vans and rural spawns live outside the city; scan on the way to other jobs.

stages.label: Rare and special
stages.tip: Chase the rare models last, when you know which ones you still need.

stages.label: Everyday traffic
stages.tip: Drive what you find: the first fifty come from normal play if you swap cars often.

stages.label: Trucks and work vehicles
stages.tip: Deliberately take the work vehicles most players skip.

stages.label: Rare spawns
stages.tip: Hunt the rare spawns last with the tracker open so you never double-count.

stages.label: Vice City districts
stages.tip: Clear the city districts on foot and by car; the map fills in as you go.

stages.label: Leonida Keys
stages.tip: Island-hop the Keys in one run; small areas count the same as big ones.

stages.label: North and inland
stages.tip: Finish the north and inland areas last; check the map for unvisited pockets.

stages.label: Easy first pass
stages.tip: Take the twenty easiest challenges first to learn the scoring.

stages.label: Skill challenges
stages.tip: The middle twenty need practice; repeat the ones you nearly pass.

stages.label: Final push
stages.tip: Last ten: pick your strongest challenge types and grind them out.

stages.label: Story-adjacent tasks
stages.tip: Tasks tied to story progress come naturally; log them as they pop.

stages.label: Open-world sweep
stages.tip: Sweep the open-world task types in one dedicated session.

stages.label: Cleanup
stages.tip: Last eight: check the list, then hunt only what is missing.

stages.label: Street races
stages.tip: Win the street series first; a tuned car carries most of them.

stages.label: Off-road and water
stages.tip: Switch vehicles for the off-road and water races; do not force one car through all of them.

stages.label: Final series
stages.tip: Last five races: the hardest fields, so bring your best vehicle.

stages.label: Decks 1–5
stages.tip: First five decks teach the patterns; take your time and learn the targets.

stages.label: Decks 6–10
stages.tip: Middle decks: same skills, tighter windows.

stages.label: Decks 11–15
stages.tip: Last five decks are the hardest; finish them in one focused run.

stages.label: Coast locations
stages.tip: Walk the coast route and log each location as the prompt appears.

stages.label: City locations
stages.tip: City locations cluster: clear them in one walk.

stages.label: Inland locations
stages.tip: Last four are spread out; use the map to route between them.

stages.label: Common cars
stages.tip: Half the list is common traffic; collect them during normal play.

stages.label: Uncommon cars
stages.tip: Hunt the uncommon five in their usual districts.

stages.label: Rare cars
stages.tip: Last three are rare spawns; check the usual spots and be patient.

stages.label: First hundred
stages.tip: The first two hundred come from normal play if you vary your actions.

stages.label: Deliberate grind
stages.tip: Set up a repeatable loop for the middle two hundred.

stages.label: Final hundred
stages.tip: Last hundred: keep the loop going and watch the tracker, not the clock.

stages.label: Story payouts
stages.tip: Story missions pay the most early; bank the first $40,000 before big purchases.

stages.label: Side income
stages.tip: Side jobs and sales stack up fast once the story opens the map.

stages.label: Top-up
stages.tip: Last $25,000: sell what you do not need and finish the highest-paying side work.

stages.label: Story payouts
stages.tip: Story missions and their payouts carry the first $100,000.

stages.label: Business and sales
stages.tip: The middle $80,000 comes from repeatable income; keep overheads low.

stages.label: Final push
stages.tip: Last $70,000: the highest-paying work, done last when payouts are best.
